taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Product-specific HSM export ceremony, quorum and recipient security domain
controls.source_trace: Determine who chooses the wrapping key and whether a protected non-export use can be converted into export under a caller-controlled key.
controls.implementation_branch: Distinguish plaintext export, wrapping and an authorized backup/replication channel. Wrapping under an attacker-controlled importable key can have different consequences from wrapping to an approved recipient, but requires actual object/mechanism permission. Inspect wrap templates, trusted-key requirements and destination control using synthetic software-token keys; no production key extraction is needed.
controls.operational_method: Specialize in the supplied product export/backup ceremony, not generic PKCS#11 wrapping. Retain partition/security-domain identity, export mode, quorum/approval evidence, recipient wrapping-key provenance and the importing destination constraints. Compare an approved synthetic-key ceremony with a missing approval or wrong recipient in vendor-supported test evidence. Software-token wrap behavior cannot certify a vendor backup mechanism; absent product artifacts leaves that ceremony unassessed.
controls.controlled_verification: Use vendor-supported supplied evidence or a test-only ceremony for a synthetic key. Compare approved quorum/recipient/security domain with a missing approval or wrong destination; never infer hardware export policy from a generic software token.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A supported backup/export API is not a defect if restricted to the approved role and destination policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind export/wrapping approval to key purpose and destination trust, preserving legitimate recovery.
